title: Sign in (password)
description: Email, then password, drawn from the step the server is waiting for. An unknown step is shown as "not supported", never as a blank card. Behaviour and security live in @tula-tech/react; this is presentation you own.
docs: Draw <SignIn onComplete={...} /> inside <TulaProvider> from @tula-tech/react. Import "@tula-tech/react/styles.css" once for the one screen the package draws itself, the "not supported" fallback.
